## What it makes

A 15-second 16:9 sequence of three shots in which the same invented person walks into a cafe, reads a letter and says goodbye in the street. It is for storytellers who need one character to stay recognisable across clips. The idea: paint the character once, register the portrait in your private asset library, and give that asset to every Seedance shot as `asset_1`.

## The workflow

<Shot src="templates/consistent-character-shots-workflow.webp" alt="The Consistent Character Shots template in four groups: character, portrait and asset, three shots, join and save" caption="Four groups. The asset link from the second group feeds all three shots." />

1. A **Character description (change me)** text node holds the character. The template uses a young woman with short curly hair, a mustard cardigan and round glasses.
2. **[Seedream 4.5 & 5.0](../../nodes/seedream/)** (Seedream 5.0 Pro, 3:4 at 1K) paints the portrait. An **Extract Text** node turns its `response` into an image link.
3. **[Create Image Asset](../../nodes/create-image-asset/)** registers that link in your private asset library, in the group "ComfyUI characters", and waits until the asset is active. A **Preview as Text** node shows the `asset://` link it outputs.
4. Three **[Seedance 2.5 Reference to Video](../../nodes/seedance-2-5-reference/)** nodes (titled "Shot 1", "Shot 2" and "Shot 3"), set to the model Seedance 2.0, each get that link as `asset_1`. Each prompt starts with `asset1`, which the node replaces with the reference. All three make 5 seconds at 720p, 16:9, with audio.
5. **Concatenate Video** (titled "Join the three shots") joins the shots in order, and **Save Video** writes the result to `BytePlus/Video/character_shots`.

## Run it

1. Add your ModelArk API key and the IAM access key and secret key in **Settings → BytePlus** if you have not yet ([API keys](../../get-started/api-keys/)). The IAM keys need asset-library permission, and your account also needs Dreamina Seedance Advanced Creation Rights.
2. Open the template browser and choose **Consistent Character Shots** under BytePlus.
3. Rewrite **Character description (change me)** and, if you like, the three shot prompts.
4. Press **Run**. The portrait comes first, then the asset, then the three shots.

## Settings worth changing

- **Character description:** be specific about hair, clothes and accessories, because the portrait is the only reference every shot gets.
- **Shot prompts:** keep `asset1` as the subject of each sentence and change the action, the place and the light.
- **`group_name` and `asset_name` in Create Image Asset:** use one group per person, so that later runs can add more assets to it.
- **`duration` and `resolution` in each shot:** 5 seconds at 720p by default.
- **A fourth shot:** copy a shot node, connect the same asset link and join it in **Concatenate Video**.

## Time and cost

The live test took 5.3 minutes. Seedream and the three Seedance nodes bill on your ModelArk account, so three video generations are billed per run. The seed controls are set to `randomize`, so every run paints a new portrait and makes three new shots and bills again. Set a control to `fixed` and ComfyUI reuses the cached result of an unchanged node without billing. The asset can be reused in later workflows: look it up with Asset Library or paste its ID into `asset_1`. No Comfy.org login is needed because the portrait goes to the asset library as a link.
